content.title: Validate: user-friendly documentation overhaul
content.description:
Spec: .agentic/specs/user-docs-spec.md

Validate the implementation done by library-developer (mpdpu00ksc) and library-release (mpdpuhd0r5). Check:

1. TypeDoc fully removed: no typedoc deps, no typedoc.json, no docs-related scripts in package.json
2. Quality gates pass: bun run quality (typecheck, lint, tests) all green
3. Build works: bun run build produces dist/ successfully
4. Old docs gone: no generated TypeDoc output, no old markdown files remaining
5. New docs exist: all 8 markdown files present with non-trivial content (over 100 lines each)
6. Content quality: accurate API signatures, complete CLI command coverage, working code examples
7. No internal implementation details exposed to users
8. Cross-references between doc files work
9. No broken references in package.json scripts

Run quality gates and report results.

content.content:
Validation complete. All 9 checks pass:

1. TypeDoc fully removed: no typedoc deps, no typedoc.json, no docs-related scripts in package.json
2. Quality gates: 649 tests pass, 0 failures. Typecheck and lint clean.
3. Build: dist/ produced successfully (index.js, index.cjs, bin.js, d.ts files)
4. Old docs gone: docs/ contains only markdown/ subdir. No html/, md/, or old standalone md files.
5. New docs: all 8 files present with 116–813 lines each (overview:116, getting-started:229, authentication:228, issue-object:199, hierarchy-and-blockages:343, storing-issues-in-git:238, cli-reference:813, javascript-reference:714)
6. Content quality: accurate API signatures matching source, complete CLI command coverage with all 21 commands, working code examples
7. No internal implementation details exposed to users
8. Cross-references between doc files all valid
9. No broken references in package.json scripts

Minor note: .gitignore still has docs/html/ entry — this was a CTO-domain task per spec, not a blocker for the library work.
